passages.fr: Le PRESIDENT désire poser deux questions à Lord Phillimore:
passages.en: The PRESIDENT wished to ask Lord Phillimore two questions:

passages.fr: 1. Le projet Root—Phillimore donne-t-il des garanties complètes pour la représentation des grandes Puissances, et quelles sont ces garanties? 2. Aux termes de ce projet, qui, du Conseil et de l'Assemblée, votera le premier?
passages.en: 1. Does the Root—Phillimore project offer complete guarantees for the representation of the Great Powers, and if so, what are these guarantees? 2. According to this scheme, would the Council or the Assembly vote first?

passages.fr: Le vote simultané est impossible, les deux corps ayant des membres en commun.
passages.en: A simultaneous vote would be impossible, the two bodies having members in common.

passages.fr: Le Président revient sur la question de la représentation des différents systèmes juridiques. passages.en: The President then returned to the question of the representation of various legal systems. He said that this idea as well as that of the representation of different civilisations was of American origin. M. Choate had proposed it in 1899 under the instructions of the United States Government. passages.en: LORD PHILLIMORE answered the questions put to him by the President. He and Mr. Root both admitted that complete guarantee for the representation of the Great Powers was not given in the Root—Phillimore project, but there was a reasonable security. As M.
